AIM Usage Policy

This policy explains the rules, responsibilities, content requirements, referral mechanics, incentives, privacy expectations, and creator conduct requirements for participation in AIM.

01 — About AIM

What is AIM?

AIM (Allo Bank Influencer Market) is a platform operated by PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk that enables registered creators and members to participate in approved marketing and referral activities for Allo Bank products and services.

AccessAvailable collaboration opportunities and approved promotional information.
Create & distributeApproved promotional content and campaign materials.
ReferShare assigned referral codes or links and track qualifying referrals.
EarnReceive incentives in accordance with applicable program terms.
Important: AIM participation does not make a creator an employee, representative, agent, financial advisor, or official spokesperson of Allo Bank unless separately agreed in writing.
02 — Who Can Participate

Creator eligibility

  1. Complete AIM registration.
  2. Provide accurate registration information.
  3. Maintain an active Allo Bank account where required by the AIM program.
  4. Agree to the Allo Bank Privacy Notice and Terms & Conditions.
  5. Agree to this AIM Usage Policy.
  6. Complete any required AIM onboarding, education, or compliance requirements.
  7. Comply with applicable laws, regulations, and AIM rules.

Participant categories

Employee Creator — an Allo Bank employee participating in the applicable employee program.

Public Creator — an external participant participating in the public AIM program.

No guarantee of collaboration: Registration does not guarantee a paid collaboration, campaign assignment, minimum number of referrals, or minimum income.
03 — Relationship With Allo Bank

Be clear about your relationship

When participating in an AIM marketing activity, creators must clearly communicate their relationship with Allo Bank in accordance with the applicable content format and requirements.

OJK requirement: The applicable OJK framework requires a financial-information presenter conducting marketing to disclose their identity and relationship with the PUJK clearly and understandably. Follow the disclosure format provided by AIM for the applicable campaign and content format.
When participating in an AIM marketing activity, you must clearly disclose that you are participating in a marketing collaboration with Allo Bank and, where applicable, that you may receive an economic benefit from the activity.
04 — Economic Benefit & Sponsored Content

Disclose economic interest

If you receive or may receive an economic benefit from your AIM activity, clearly disclose the existence of that economic interest.

Depending on the content format, disclosure may appear in a video end-tag, caption/post description, text overlay, or another format specified by AIM.

Konten ini merupakan bagian dari kerja sama dengan Allo Bank dan saya dapat memperoleh manfaat ekonomis dari aktivitas ini.
05 — General Content Principles

Accurate. Clear. Honest. Not misleading.

Every creator is responsible for ensuring information they publish follows the applicable requirements and approved campaign materials.

AccurateDo not publish information that is factually incorrect.
ClearUse language ordinary consumers can understand.
HonestDo not exaggerate or omit material information in a way that creates a misleading impression.
Not misleadingDo not create false expectations about approval, credit limit, pricing, benefits, eligibility, repayment, promotions, or availability.
OJK-aligned principle: Applicable requirements emphasize information that is clear, accurate, honest, accessible/easy to understand, and not potentially misleading.
06 — Allo Bank PayLater Content

Product risk & consumer disclosure

When communicating about Allo Bank PayLater, creators must communicate the applicable risk information and disclaimer.

OJK BNPL / PayLater requirement: The applicable framework provides requirements for buy-now-pay-later communications, including a statement that the product/service carries risk, a disclaimer for consumers to conduct their own analysis before deciding to use it, and a statement that the product/service may not be suitable for all consumers or members of the public.
Produk dan layanan ini memiliki risiko. Lakukan analisis pribadi terlebih dahulu sebelum menggunakan produk dan layanan ini. Produk dan layanan ini belum tentu sesuai untuk seluruh kalangan.
Do not: guarantee approval; guarantee a particular credit limit; claim everyone will be approved; claim using PayLater is risk-free; or make unsupported claims about financial benefits.
07 — Regulatory Statement

Use the approved Allo Bank statement

Where required by applicable regulation and campaign format, creators must include the prescribed regulatory statement regarding Allo Bank's status as a PUJK.

PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk berizin dan diawasi oleh Otoritas Jasa Keuangan.

Control: The exact wording, placement, and applicable use cases should follow Allo Bank's approved campaign template and Legal & Compliance guidance.

Regulatory references: AIM marketing activities should follow the latest applicable OJK requirements and Allo Bank Legal & Compliance instructions. The policy draft identifies POJK No. 6 Tahun 2026 and PADK No. 37/PADK.08/2025 as relevant references.
08 — Approved Products & Campaigns

Only promote active AIM offers

Creators may only promote products, services, promotions, benefits, and offers that are currently approved and available through AIM.

Creators must not independently invent promotional benefits, discounts, cashback, interest/rate claims, credit-limit promises, eligibility criteria, or campaign periods.

Campaign validity: Check that the promotion remains valid before publishing or continuing to distribute promotional content. If a promotion has expired, stop promoting the expired offer.
09 — Content Creation & AIM Approval

Submit the exact version you intend to publish

1
Creator Upload
2
AI Compliance Check
3
Human Review
4
Approved / Rejected / Revision

Content approval applies only to the exact version submitted and approved. If you subsequently change the video, voice-over, caption, claim, promotion, disclaimer, visual, CTA, or other material content, the modified version may fall outside the original approval.

Approval does not transfer responsibility: AIM content approval is a compliance control. It does not mean Allo Bank becomes the author of the content or that the creator is released from responsibility for the published content.
10 — Independent Publishing

Your independently created content remains your responsibility

A creator may distribute an AIM referral code or link through their own channels where permitted by the relevant campaign.

Important: Content independently created or modified outside the AIM review process remains the creator's responsibility. Creators must still comply with this Policy and applicable laws and regulations.
11 — Creator Conduct

Participate in good faith

Do not misrepresent Allo Bank

  • Claim to be an official Allo Bank representative when you are not.
  • Imply authority you do not have.
  • Make commitments on behalf of Allo Bank.

Do not manipulate referrals

  • Create fictitious customers.
  • Submit duplicate or fabricated referrals.
  • Manipulate attribution.
  • Attempt to generate incentives through dishonest activity.
  • Deliberately circumvent AIM rules.

Do not misuse information

  • Disclose confidential Allo Bank information.
  • Use internal information for unauthorized public communication.
  • Disclose customer information.
12 — Customer Data & Privacy

Protect customer information

Creators must respect customer privacy and must not:

  • Request unnecessary customer personal information.
  • Collect customer credentials.
  • Ask customers for OTPs, passwords, PINs, or other authentication information.
  • Store customer personal information unnecessarily.
  • Share customer information with third parties.
  • Use customer information for purposes unrelated to the applicable referral activity.
Customer assistance: If a customer asks for help with an application, direct the customer to the official Allo Bank channel rather than requesting sensitive information.
13 — Referral Code Rules

Use only your assigned referral code

Each creator receives a referral code associated with their AIM account.

  • Use only your assigned referral code.
  • Do not sell or transfer your referral code.
  • Do not falsely represent another creator's code as your own.
  • Do not manipulate referral attribution.

A customer must use the applicable creator referral code during the designated registration/application process. A customer cannot claim multiple creator codes for the same qualifying application.

14 — Incentive Rules

Current AIM incentive structure

PartyIncentive
CreatorRp150,000
Qualifying CustomerRp100,000
Total acquisition incentiveRp250,000

The applicable campaign terms may specify different or additional conditions.

Current PayLater qualifying criteria

  • Unique first-time registration.
  • Correct creator attribution.
  • Successful PayLater activation with approved credit limit of at least Rp1,000,000.

No incentive for non-qualifying activity

No incentive is payable for duplicate customers, invalid or fabricated referrals, incorrect attribution, non-qualifying applications, or activity that does not meet applicable campaign terms.

15–17 — Account Actions & Appeal

Incentive, suspension, termination & appeal

Incentive & disciplinary separation

A creator's disciplinary status and entitlement to an already-qualified incentive are separate matters. Where a referral has already satisfied applicable qualifying conditions, the incentive remains payable even if the creator is subsequently suspended or terminated, subject to reconciliation and payment processes.

Suspension & termination

AIM may suspend or terminate participation where there is a serious violation of this Policy, campaign terms, applicable laws/regulations, or other Allo Bank requirements.

  • Materially misleading or false claims.
  • Fraudulent or fabricated referrals.
  • Manipulation of the incentive mechanism.
  • Misuse of confidential information.
  • Impersonation or misrepresentation of Allo Bank authority.
  • Conduct creating significant regulatory, legal, customer-protection, financial, or reputational risk.
  • Repeated material violations after correction/instruction.

Not every mistake is automatically a serious violation.

Appeal

Creators may appeal a suspension or termination through the designated AIM channel. The appeal should identify the relevant action, explain the creator's position, and provide supporting evidence where relevant.

18 — Promotion Expiry

Stop expired promotions

Creators are responsible for checking promotion validity before publishing or redistributing content. AIM may associate content with a promotion ID, identify content associated with an expired promotion, notify the creator, and take operational action available within AIM.

19 — Content Records & Audit

Records may be retained for governance

AIM may retain creator-submitted content and relevant activity records for legitimate purposes including compliance, audit, dispute investigation, performance reporting, regulatory requirements, legal purposes, and internal governance.

Records may include submitted content, submission date/time, creator AIM account, approval status, campaign/promotion association, referral activity, and relevant review history. Retention periods follow applicable Allo Bank policies and Legal/Compliance requirements.

20 — Customer & Creator Complaints

How issues are handled

1
Customer / Creator
2
Allo Bank Customer Care
3
AIM PIC
4
Investigation → Resolution

The standard route applies to referral attribution, creator incentives, customer incentives, qualifying status, and other AIM-related issues. The target investigation and resolution period is 5–10 business days, subject to complexity and information availability.

21 — Creator Independence & Non-Exclusivity

AIM is not automatically exclusive

Unless a separate written agreement states otherwise, creators may participate in other legitimate commercial activities.

Creators must continue to comply with applicable disclosure requirements, campaign-specific restrictions, confidentiality obligations, conflict-of-interest requirements, and applicable laws and regulations.

22–23 — Policy Changes & Acknowledgement

Policy updates & acceptance

Allo Bank may update this Policy to reflect regulatory changes, product changes, campaign changes, operational improvements, security requirements, or changes to AIM functionality.

Version control: Every acceptance should record the applicable Policy Version and timestamp.

Creator acknowledgement

“I have read, understood, and agree to comply with the AIM Usage Policy, including the rules regarding content, disclosures, product information, referral activity, incentives, customer privacy, and creator conduct.”
